title: Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Which Should a Pakistani Business Use First?
desc: Google Ads reaches people already searching, Meta Ads reaches people while they browse. Learn which fits your business first, and when to use both.
answer: Google Ads shows your business to people who are actively searching for what you sell. Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) shows your business to people who match an audience you choose while they browse. Start with Google Ads when customers already search for your service. Start with Meta Ads when your offer is visual, new or needs to be introduced first.
body: h2
How the two platforms work
p

Google Ads is built around search intent. Someone types "AC repair near me" or "digital marketing agency" and your ad can appear next to the results. The person already wants something, so you are meeting existing demand.
p

Meta Ads runs on Facebook and Instagram. People are not searching; they are scrolling. You choose who sees the ad by location, age, interests and other options, and the ad has to catch attention on its own. Here you are creating interest rather than only capturing it.
h2
When Google Ads is usually the better first step
ul
Customers already search for your service, for example plumbers, clinics, tutors, repair services or agencies.
You want enquiries from people who are ready to call or message.
Your service area is clear, such as one city.
h2
When Meta Ads is usually the better first step
ul
Your product is visual, such as fashion, furniture, food or interiors.
Few people search for your product by name because it is new or unfamiliar.
You want to build an audience and collect leads through forms or WhatsApp messages.
h2
Using both together
p

Many businesses use both over time. Google Ads captures people who are ready now. Meta Ads reminds people who visited but did not enquire, and introduces the business to new audiences. Starting with both on a small budget can spread your money too thin, so most businesses begin with one and add the second once tracking works.
h2
Questions to ask before you choose
ul
Do people search for what I sell? If yes, test Google Ads.
Does my product look good in a photo or short video? If yes, test Meta Ads.
Is my website or landing page clear on a phone? Neither platform fixes a confusing page.
Can I follow up on every enquiry quickly? Slow replies waste ad spend on both platforms.
p
The right answer depends on your offer, market and budget. We look at these with you in a free consultation before recommending a channel.
faq: Is Google Ads or Meta Ads cheaper?
Neither is always cheaper. Cost depends on your industry, city, competition, ad quality and website. Compare cost per enquiry, not cost per click.
Can a small business use both Google Ads and Meta Ads?
Yes. Many start with one platform, make sure tracking works, then add the other as results and budget allow.
Both can send visitors soon after the ads are approved, but it takes time to learn what works. No agency can honestly guarantee leads or sales.
